title: Append mandatory “Condições Gerais de Venda e Garantia” page to every Orçamento print/PDF output

requirements.summary: Always append a new A4 page to the orçamento print/PDF output containing the exact user-provided Portuguese “CONDIÇÕES GERAIS DE VENDA E GARANTIA …” text with preserved line breaks/bullets.
acceptanceCriteria: From the orçamento PDF/print dialog, generating/printing any orçamento results in at least 2 pages: (1) the existing orçamento layout unchanged, (2) a new appended page containing the full provided terms text.
The appended page text matches the user-provided content exactly (no omissions or edits), and renders with preserved paragraphing/line breaks (e.g., via CSS white-space handling).
The new terms page is included regardless of orçamento contents (items, observations, desconto/IVA, etc.).

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated exported constant containing the full user-provided Portuguese terms text verbatim (including all line breaks and bullet structure), to be injected into the print HTML without edits.

Update the HTML + window.print generation to always render an additional A4 `.page` immediately after the existing orçamento page containing the terms text from `orcamentoGeneralTermsPT` (rendered with preserved line breaks via `white-space: pre-wrap` or equivalent), without modifying the existing first page markup/styles beyond adding the new page after it.

requirements.summary: Ensure deterministic page ordering when imagemAdicional exists: orçamento page first, then terms page, then imagemAdicional page.
acceptanceCriteria: When imagemAdicional exists, printing generates 3 pages in order: orçamento, terms text page, imagemAdicional page.
When imagemAdicional does not exist, printing generates 2 pages in order: orçamento, terms text page.

file_operations.description: Reorder the generated print HTML so the new terms `.page` is always inserted after the orçamento page and before the conditional imagemAdicional `.page` (keeping imagemAdicional logic intact), ensuring deterministic ordering in both cases.
